title: How to Remove Sync Follower
symptom: After changing smartphone for a follower, the old follower cannot be removed and xDrip shows the message 'No follower sync for: xxx time' because the old follower phone is turned off.
evidence_quote: The follower will likely expire automatically after a while. If you want to cut off an active follower (which I don't think is what you're talking about here) then you would change the group sync security key.
